org.portico.utils.messaging

Class ResponseMessage

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.portico.utils.messaging.ResponseMessage
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Serializable
    Direct Known Subclasses:
    ErrorResponse, ExtendedSuccessMessage

    public class ResponseMessage
extends Object
implements Serializable
    For each Request that is sent, a response is needed. This class is the parent of all response messages. This class can represent either a basic "success" or "error" response via its isError() flag. Users can design their own custom response types (the same way they design their own requests) by extending this class. For your convenience, the messaging framework provides a couple of helper extensions:
    • ExtendedSuccessMessage: A "success" message that allows values to be returned with it (the ResponseMessage class only allows you to mark as response as a success or failure).
    • ErrorResponse: An "error" message that allows additional error information to be provided with the response. This includes things like an Exception or an error message.
    See Also:

      • isError

        public boolean isError()

      • isSuccess

        public boolean isSuccess()
        Returns true if this message represents an success response, false otherwise.

      • getResult

        public Object getResult()
        If this message is an ExtendedSuccessMessage, this method will fetch the "result" object from it and return it (see the javadoc for that class). If this class is not an instance of ExtendedSuccessMessage, null will be returned. This is the case even if this message is a "success" (isError() == false) because by default, a success message doesn't need to have an associated result.

      • getResult

        public Object getResult(String key)
        If this message is an ExtendedSuccessMessage, this method will fetch the HashMap contained inside it and return the value it has at the given key. If this instance isn't an ExtendedSuccessMessage, or the key doesn't exist in the map, null is returned.

      • setResult

        public void setResult(Object result)
               throws MessagingException
        If this message is an ExtendedSuccessMessage, this method will call the ExtendedSuccessMessage.setResult(Object) method on it, passing the given value. If it isn't an ExtendedSuccessMessage, an exception will be thrown.
        Throws:
        MessagingException

      • setResult

        public void setResult(String key,
                      Object value)
               throws MessagingException
        If this message is an ExtendedSuccessMessage, this method will call the ExtendedSuccessMessage.setResult(String, Object) method on it, passing the given key and value. This will associate the value with the key in the map of results that are contained in the response. If this instance isn't an ExtendedSuccessMessage, an exception will be thrown.
        Throws:
        MessagingException

      • getError

        public Exception getError()
        If this response is an ErrorResponse, this method will extract it and fetch the cause of the error, casting it to an Exception before returning it (it is stored as a Throwable). If this isn't an instance of ErrorResponse, null is returned.
